note: Known language archives of non-English retail installs (path, size, md5; hashes only). They replace the policies' English lang/*.big archives (the entries whose language is not ALL) when the install holds that language. A language that is not listed here is still mounted, with a warning (OPENBFME_STRICT_LANGUAGE=1 refuses it). The paths keep the English entries' case style, so the archives sort into the same mount order.
